title: Who is involved: Don't Panic Tour

story.text:
# Who is involved

**Active cast.** Named actors: "Andrea is doing" a class of "like 15 of them" building an early guide "at their university"; "that university is involved." "Oscar," "another hitchhiker," is floated to "get Oscar in" for shows. The group itself organises the tour, manifesto/declaration and marketing "leading and indicating towards that November event." For radio they want "art students and the musicians and the coders to help us vibe code that radio station." Note the deliberate shift: "it's no longer the internal mice that are creating software... It's now external people."

**Being invited or network activated.** "Hopefully, Audrey's involved" (Audrey Tang); the "stability AI guy"; a "sovereign data center"; possibly a frontier provider "XAI" or "Gemini 3" (Claude already "sponsored" for Andrea's students). The "Raspberry Pi Foundation" for the Marvelette. A Marvin "casting call": "voice of Marvin," "write the training data set," critical-voice testers. H2G2 OGs invited "to be a mentor." Provider "priority order" remains an open decision.
See [[Don't Panic Tour]]  ·  hub: [[Who is Involved?]]
